form.label: Configuration
form.description: Find the indexes that hold the Aruba Central data and the Aruba syslog data, then set the macros aruba_central_index and aruba_syslog_index. No restart needed.

div.p: This app shows data that the add-on TA_hpe_aruba_central has collected from the New Central API (sourcetypes aruba:central:*). If it finds nothing, install and configure the add-on first.

Syslog from Aruba gateways, controllers and access points is optional. It is typically received by Splunk Connect for Syslog (SC4S) as sourcetype aruba:syslog (default index netops). The add-on TA-aruba_networks renames it to one sourcetype per process, for example aruba:authmgr or aruba:stm. Both searches below look at the last 24 hours.

table.title: Candidate indexes for Aruba Central data (sourcetype=aruba:central:*)

search.query: | metasearch index=* sourcetype=aruba:central:* | stats count by index, sourcetype | sort - count

table.title: Candidate indexes for Aruba syslog (sourcetype=aruba:*, without aruba:central:*)

search.query: | metasearch index=* (sourcetype=aruba:* OR sourcetype=aruba) NOT sourcetype=aruba:central:* | stats count by index | sort - count

div.p: Enter the full search expression, for example index=aruba or (index=aruba OR index=network). The current values are pre-filled.
div.label: aruba_central_index (New Central API data)
aruba_syslog_index (Aruba syslog, optional)
div.p: The macros are stored in local/macros.conf of this app and apply to all dashboards immediately. The macro aruba_syslog adds the sourcetype filter to aruba_syslog_index. If you have no Aruba syslog, keep the default: the syslog panels then stay empty.

Shows for every data source whether events arrive with the saved macros, when the last event came in and how many events arrived per hour over the last 24 hours. Green: data is fresh. Amber: the source delivers, but the last event is older than expected. Red: the Central source delivered nothing in 24 hours. Grey: optional or event-driven source without data. The check refreshes when you save the macros.

table.title: Source check (last 24 hours, with the saved macros)

search.query: `aruba_central_index` sourcetype="aruba:central:*" | stats count as Events latest(_time) as last sparkline(count,1h) as Trend by sourcetype | append [| makeresults | eval sourcetype=split("aruba:central:ap,aruba:central:ap_throughput,aruba:central:site_health,aruba:central:device,aruba:central:device_inventory,aruba:central:alert",",") | mvexpand sourcetype | eval Events=0 | fields sourcetype Events] | dedup sourcetype | eval Source=case(sourcetype="aruba:central:ap","Access points",sourcetype="aruba:central:ap_throughput","Access point throughput",sourcetype="aruba:central:site_health","Site health",sourcetype="aruba:central:device","Switches and gateways",sourcetype="aruba:central:device_inventory","Device inventory",sourcetype="aruba:central:alert","Alerts",sourcetype="aruba:central:swarm","Swarm clusters (optional)",true(),sourcetype) | eval Origin="Aruba Central" | eval max_age=case(sourcetype="aruba:central:ap" OR sourcetype="aruba:central:swarm",10,sourcetype="aruba:central:ap_throughput",45,sourcetype="aruba:central:site_health",30,sourcetype="aruba:central:device" OR sourcetype="aruba:central:device_inventory",90,true(),1440) | eval age_min=if(isnull(last),null(),round((now()-last)/60)) | eval Status=case(sourcetype="aruba:central:alert" AND Events=0,"● None in 24 h",sourcetype="aruba:central:swarm" AND Events=0,"● Not collected",Events=0,"● No data",sourcetype="aruba:central:alert","● OK",age_min<=max_age,"● OK",true(),"● Delayed") | append [search `aruba_syslog` | stats count as Events latest(_time) as last sparkline(count,1h) as Trend | eval Source="Aruba syslog", Origin="Syslog (optional)", age_min=round((now()-last)/60), Status=case(Events=0,"● Optional, no data",age_min<=15,"● OK",true(),"● Delayed")] | eval Last=if(isnull(last),"-",strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")), "Age (min)"=age_min | fillnull value=0 Events | eval order=case(Origin="Aruba Central",0,true(),1) | sort order Source | table Status Origin Source Events Trend Last "Age (min)"

format.colorPalette: {"● OK":#53A051,"● Delayed":#D99B1E,"● No data":#DC4E41,"● None in 24 h":#708794,"● Not collected":#708794,"● Optional, no data":#708794}
